structured.answer: I'm not moving anything. I'll ask you or the bank. As far as I could see, Harel takes about half a percent a year from the savings, under the 1.05% the law allows. But I only saw one kind of product (קופת גמל להשקעה), nothing like a deposit, and for most tracks it just says "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a return.

stuck.where: Product buttons under 'כל המוצרים של הראל'
stuck.why: None says פיקדון or anything I know as safe. Only קופת גמל להשקעה was open, and I didn't know which button to press for 'everything'.
Most rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I couldn't see how those tracks did
It looked the calmest, but I don't know whether 'כספי' means safe like a deposit
I wasn't sure what 'מההיסכון' versus 'מההפקדות' means

used: Title 'הראל' and the line about data from רשות שוק ההון
skimmed: Second row of track buttons (עוקב מדד, S&P 500, גמיש…)
skipped: Folded sections קרנות מחקות, מרכזות לפיצויים, קרנות סל
Other product tabs (קרן השתלמות, חיסכון לכל ילד, etc.)
not_found: Anything called פיקדון or a safe option compared to a deposit
A plain sentence saying which track is safe
The return after fees and tax

findings.what: No option labelled as safe or compared to a bank deposit. I can't tell whether 'כספי' is safe.
Most tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of any return, so I couldn't judge how they did
Dark background with a crowded table of many numbers and long lines. Tiring and frightening.
Small grey line about extra 'הוצאות ישירות' that I couldn't read properly
English letters 'S&P 500' and terms like 'עוקב מדד' and 'גמיש' without explanation
Only one product (קופת גמל להשקעה) is shown. The rest are behind buttons and folds.
Returns are 'לפני דמי הניהול ולפני מס', so the numbers are bigger than what I'd actually get
Coloured rings for מניות/מט"ח use colours I can't tell apart, and there's no sentence saying what they mean
At the bottom it says 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי'. It isn't Harel and I don't know who made it.
